scripts.pack:mac: npm run build:web && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.js --mac dir
scripts.build:mac:recovery: export APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE=${APPLE_KEYCHAIN_PROFILE:-elevate-notarization}; electron-builder --config electron-builder.recovery.config.js --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.smoke:mac: node scripts/candidate-receipt.js verify-final && mkdir -p dist/evidence && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').release.version") && APP_BUNDLE=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').release.profile.appBundleName") && DESKTOP_ROOT=$(pwd -P) && PYTHON=${ELEVATE_RELEASE_PYTHON:-../cli/.venv/bin/python} && "$PYTHON" -B ../cli/scripts/installed_runtime_smoke.py --installed-app "$DESKTOP_ROOT/dist/mac/$APP_BUNDLE" --expected-app-version "$VERSION" --candidate-receipt dist/candidate-receipt.json --candidate-architecture x64 --json-out dist/evidence/smoke-x64.json --skip-sidecar && "$PYTHON" -B ../cli/scripts/installed_runtime_smoke.py --installed-app "$DESKTOP_ROOT/dist/mac-arm64/$APP_BUNDLE" --expected-app-version "$VERSION" --candidate-receipt dist/candidate-receipt.json --candidate-architecture arm64 --json-out dist/evidence/smoke-arm64.json --skip-sidecar
scripts.smoke:mac:live: node scripts/candidate-receipt.js verify-final --require-static-evidence && mkdir -p dist/evidence && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').release.version") && APP_BUNDLE=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').release.profile.appBundleName") && PRODUCT_NAME=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').release.profile.productName") && HOME_NAME=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').release.profile.elevateHomeName") && CANDIDATE_ID=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').candidate_id") && SHORT_ID=$(printf %.12s "$CANDIDATE_ID") && EXPECTED="live candidate $SHORT_ID ok" && ARCH=$(node -p "process.arch") && INSTALLED_APP=${ELEVATE_LIVE_APP:-"$HOME/Applications/$APP_BUNDLE"} && MAIN_LOG="$HOME/Library/Logs/$PRODUCT_NAME/main.log" && PYTHON=${ELEVATE_RELEASE_PYTHON:-../cli/.venv/bin/python} && ELEVATE_HOME="$HOME/$HOME_NAME" "$PYTHON" -B ../cli/scripts/installed_runtime_smoke.py --live-candidate --installed-app "$INSTALLED_APP" --main-log "$MAIN_LOG" --expected-app-version "$VERSION" --candidate-receipt dist/candidate-receipt.json --candidate-architecture "$ARCH" --prompt "Reply exactly: $EXPECTED" --expected "$EXPECTED" --json-out dist/evidence/live-ai.json && npm run gate:realtor-beta
scripts.gate:realtor-beta: node scripts/candidate-receipt.js verify-final --require-static-evidence && CHANNEL=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').release.channel") && if [ "$CHANNEL" != beta ]; then exit 0; fi && APP_BUNDLE=$(node -p "require('./dist/candidate-receipt.json').release.profile.appBundleName") && ARCH=$(node -p "process.arch") && INSTALLED_APP=${ELEVATE_LIVE_APP:-"$HOME/Applications/$APP_BUNDLE"} && PYTHON=${ELEVATE_RELEASE_PYTHON:-../cli/.venv/bin/python} && "$PYTHON" -B ../cli/scripts/exact_candidate_realtor_beta_gate.py --candidate-receipt dist/candidate-receipt.json --installed-app "$INSTALLED_APP" --candidate-architecture "$ARCH" --json-out dist/evidence/realtor-beta-gate.json
scripts.release:mac: npm run build:mac && npm run finalize:mac && npm run smoke:mac
scripts.release:apple: npm run preflight:apple && npm run release:mac
